title: Average inflation rate in the United States from 1980 to 2031
author: Sigma Capital
metaDescription: The average inflation rate in the United States from 1980 to 2025 was about 3.2% annually. The highest rate was in 1980 at 12.5%. The lowest was in 1983 at 3.8%
